name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
provider: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MoMSME) / KVIC
description: Credit-linked subsidy program aimed at generating self-employment micro-enterprises in non-farm sector.

name: PM Formalisation of Micro food processing Enterprises Scheme
description: Centrally sponsored scheme providing 35% capital subsidy for upgrading and formalizing micro food processing units.

name: Animal Husbandry Infrastructure Development Fund
provider: Department of Animal Husbandry and Dairying (DAHD), MoFAHD
description: Incentivizes investments in dairy processing, value-addition infrastructure, meat processing and animal feed plants.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
provider: MUDRA Ltd. / Department of Financial Services
description: Provides formal collateral-free loans up to Rs 20 Lakhs across Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, and Tarun Plus categories.
